page: Microsoft Azure D8plds_v6 is an ARM-based virtual machine belonging to the Dpldsv6 server family. It is configured with 8 dedicated vCPUs powered by a Microsoft Neoverse-N2 processor running at 3.4 GHz. The architecture is arm64, featuring 8 physical cores with a single thread per core. Memory capacity is 16.0 GB, yielding a resource density of 2.0 GB of RAM per core. The server includes a local 472 GB NVMe SSD and is capable of utilizing Premium Storage.

Performance benchmarks place this instance mostly in the average tier. The single-core and multi-core stress-ng benchmarks achieved scores of 2073.29 and 16574.2 respectively. Single-threaded gzip compression is a notable strength, performing in the top 25% at 33.05 GB/sec. Conversely, cryptographic performance is relatively weak, with the PassMark CPU encryption test scoring 1492.59. Memory bandwidth tests show 910.4 GB/sec for cached small blocks and 169.64 GB/sec for uncached large blocks. Redis SET operations reached 16.63 million operations per second, and static web serving throughput was measured at 15.55 GB/sec.

Given its 1:2 vCPU-to-RAM ratio, this server offers a compute-focused hardware profile with a lower memory footprint, making it a qualitatively cost-efficient option for workloads that do not require massive memory allocations. The inclusion of a fast local NVMe SSD provides high-speed temporary storage. This configuration is well-suited for tasks such as web serving, software compilation, lightweight database operations, and basic text or image processing.
